title: Projection compatibility of Cartesian proper/open graph interchange
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and f:X→Y, g:Y→Z arbitrary scheme morphisms. Let a:X→W, r:V→Y, p:P→T, q:T→Z be proper, and e:W→V, k:V→P, i:Y→T open immersions, with a e r=f, i q=g, and the square (r,k,i,p) Cartesian [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data]. On the ordinary unbounded constant-A derived categories write S(M)=Rr_*(De_!(Ra_*M)), H(M)=R(p q)_*(D(e k)_!(Ra_*M)) and G(N)=Rq_*(Di_!N). Let I:S⋙G≅H be the specified proper/open exchange followed by the open and proper compositors, with the identity-direct-image normalization cancelled. For every M in D(X_et,A) and K in D(Z_et,A), the successive projection for G and the graph-word projection for S [def-sf-etale-graph-word-projection], followed by I at M tensor Lf*Lg*K, equals tensoring I_M with K, the graph-word projection for H, and H applied to M tensor the canonical pullback compositor L(fg)*K→Lf*Lg*K. This is the Cartesian interchange square alone: no compactification of f or fg, no neighborhood-shrinking comparison, and no quasi-compactness, boundedness or Noetherianity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Put f0=e r and form the compactification c=(e,r) of f0 and ce=(e k,p) of f0 i. The Cartesian square and e k p=e r i provide a compatible compactification tower over (i,q). Apply the existing general tower_projection_canonical proof, with its explicit exchange/open-composition/proper-composition word, to Ra M and K. This is the proof underlying projectionMapOfCompactification_tower_comp; no compactification of f is required.

Factor each graph-word projection through the compactification (e,r), respectively (e k,p q), on Ra M, then the proper projection for a and the inverse pullback compositor. Expand the compactification projection using projectionMapOfCompactification_explicit. Proper-projection naturality at the inverse pullback compositor and inverse threefold pullback associativity turn this into exactly the successive three-factor graph word. This avoids dependent elimination of the compactification equality.

Cancel the identity-direct-image normalization in I. The Cartesian normalization of etaleGraphNormalizedProperOpenExchange identifies the remaining comparison with the actual openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchangeIso. Naturality of the proper compositor moves the open compositor to exactly the order used in the tower proof.

Apply naturality of this interchange to the proper projection for a. Substitute the tower equation. The mixed hom/inverse form of threefold pullback associativity gives La(c_f0,g) followed by c_a,f0 inverse equal to c_a,f0g inverse followed by c_f,g. Functoriality and coefficient naturality paste these equalities to give the displayed square.

lean.statement:
theorem sfGraphInterchange_projection
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (d : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g)
    (sq : IsPullback d.r d.k d.i d.p)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Z) :
    let I := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (d.sourcePresentation.functor A)
      (etaleGraphOpenNormalization A d.compactification).symm ≪≫
        etaleGraphDiagramInterchange A d
    sfCompactProjection A d.compactification ((d.sourcePresentation.functor A).obj M) K ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          d.compactification).map
          (sfGraphWordProjection A d.sourcePresentation M
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)) ≫
        I.hom.app (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K))) =
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).map (I.hom.app M)).app K ≫
        sfGraphWordProjection A d.compositePresentation M K ≫
        (d.compositePresentation.functor A).map
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
            ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g).hom.app K))
